title: The open locus of $H^0$ of the structure sheaf
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $X$ a
smooth projective curve over
$k$ with $H^0(X,\mathcal{O}_X)=k$ and $T$ a scheme over $k$. Then
$f_{T,*}\mathcal{O}_{X_T}\cong\mathcal{O}_T$, where $f_T:X_T\to T$ is the structure
morphism of the base change.

proof.text:
Since $X$ is projective over $k$, it is proper over $k$ ([lem-pc-projective-proper]). Write $\eta:\mathcal{O}_T\to f_{T,*}\mathcal{O}_{X_T}$ for the canonical map of sheaves of rings on $T$ (adjoint to $f_T^\#$). A morphism of sheaves is an isomorphism as soon as it is bijective on sections over every open of a basis of the topology, and the affine opens form such a basis; so it suffices to show that $\eta(V)$ is bijective for every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq T$. Since $f_T^{-1}(V)=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}A=X_A$, the map $\eta(V)$ is the canonical map $A\to\Gamma(X_A,\mathcal{O}_{X_A})$. The $k$-algebra $A$ is flat over the field $k$, so [lem-sc-flat-base-change-coherent] with $i=0$, $k'=A$ and $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{O}_X$ (whose pullback is $\mathcal{O}_{X_A}$) gives the canonical isomorphism

$$
\Gamma(X,\mathcal{O}_X)\otimes_kA\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\Gamma(X_A,\mathcal{O}_{X_A}),\qquad s\otimes a\mapsto \mathrm{pr}^*(s)\,a .
$$

As $\Gamma(X,\mathcal{O}_X)=k$, the source is $k\otimes_kA=A$, and the composite $A\to\Gamma(X_A,\mathcal{O}_{X_A})$ is $a\mapsto a\cdot1=\eta(V)(a)$. Hence $\eta(V)$ is bijective for every affine $V$, and $\eta:\mathcal{O}_T\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{T,*}\mathcal{O}_{X_T}$.
